description: This file contains partial class definitions, extensions, and configuration options related to DynamoDB reminders in the Orleans framework. It defines options classes, extension methods for service registration, and some class members likely used for configuring DynamoDB-based reminder storage.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for DynamoDB reminder storage, including capacity units, table name, and creation policies.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderStorageOptionsExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for parsing connection strings into DynamoDBReminderStorageOptions.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Options related to the DynamoDB reminder table, including connection string with potential redact attribute.

classes.name: DynamoDBClientOptions
classes.description: Client configuration options for DynamoDB access, including credentials, service, and token.

methods.name: ParseConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a connection string and applies settings to the DynamoDBReminderStorageOptions instance.

methods.name: UseDynamoDBReminderService
methods.description: Extension method to add DynamoDB reminder service to the services collection or silo builder.
